name: Yamakawa Kumi
source:
Koudai's older sister. She is a modern schoolgirl who is taking her school life for granted. She is a little annoyed with her overly energetic little brother.

She is aware of the Supponpon God.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/LRG/lrg_info.html]Official site[/url]]
